contentType.description: The type of content (e.g., MIME type).

created.description: The timestamp when the item was created.

etag.description: The ETag value for the item, used for cache validation.

favourite.description: Whether the item is marked as a favourite.

id.description: The unique identifier of the item.

itemType.description: The type of item, either 'folder' or 'file'.

key.description: The unique key for the item.

lastModified.description: The timestamp when the item was last modified.

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the item.

size.description: The size of the item in bytes.
